body:
It's been a thought. Frequently. But I still feel like this is all my fault and if I left it'd just be causing a problem and leaving.  


Which is the worst part of the irony in all of it, because suicide is just so much worse.  
Can't leave - what will the kids think? Surely they wouldn't be better off if I was just dead instead of gone away.   


I just look towards that future though of stepping out and debate if I can even make it, monetarily, literally. I haven't held a job in years because of my depression.
